name: Environment credential isolation
verification: Production identities/secrets cannot be reused by lower environments except explicitly approved non-secret references.

name: Production access control
verification: Production admin/deployment access uses Phase 28 least privilege, MFA/JIT and audit controls.

name: Signed/provenance artifacts
verification: Production artifacts have approved integrity/provenance verification.

name: IaC secret scanning
verification: IaC/config commits are scanned for secrets and unsafe patterns.

name: Policy-as-code
verification: Network/storage/identity/encryption baseline policies are automatically checked where feasible.

name: Artifact registry security
verification: Artifact push/promotion/delete permissions are restricted and audited.

name: CI runner isolation
verification: Build/deploy runners have bounded credentials and environment access.

name: Deployment impersonation prevention
verification: Release/deployment actions identify approved actor/service identity and cannot be spoofed through untrusted inputs.

name: Webhook/CI trigger validation
verification: External CI/CD triggers use authenticated/validated sources and least privilege.

name: Observability access
verification: Production logs/traces/metrics obey data classification and role restrictions.

name: Backup access
verification: Backup stores/keys are isolated from ordinary application/admin deletion paths where feasible.

name: Restore authorization
verification: Production restore actions require explicit authorized operational/security workflow.

name: DR credentials
verification: DR environments and failover identities are maintained/tested without weakening credential controls.

name: Runbook secrets
verification: Runbooks do not embed live production secrets.

name: Debug protection
verification: Debug endpoints/profilers are disabled or strongly restricted in production.

name: Non-production data
verification: Lower environments use masked/synthetic data unless protected production-derived data is specifically approved.

name: Supply-chain gate
verification: Dependencies/base images/build actions satisfy Phase 28 supply-chain checks.

name: Operational audit integrity
verification: Release/deployment/access/restore/DR audit evidence is protected from ordinary mutation.

name: Break-glass production access
verification: Emergency access is time-bound, monitored and retrospectively reviewed.

name: Cost/FinOps data security
verification: Cost allocation details and provider account metadata are restricted by role.
